title: opentelemetry Module
content_markdown: The _opentelemetry_ module provides OpenTelemetry tracing for OpenSIPS route execution. It creates a root span per processed SIP message and a child span for each route entry.
overview: The _opentelemetry_ module provides OpenTelemetry tracing for OpenSIPS route execution. It creates a root span per processed SIP message and a child span for each route entry.
how_it_works: The root SIP message span follows a local semantic convention inspired by the OpenTelemetry HTTP span conventions: it uses a method-plus-target span name, server/client/internal span kinds based on the OpenSIPS route type, and generic network, client, server and URL attributes wherever they fit the SIP model. Spans include common SIP attributes (request method, Call-ID, CSeq, response status) and connection metadata. While a span is active, OpenSIPS logs can be attached as OpenTelemetry events for easier correlation. Trace data is exported via the OTLP/HTTP exporter from the OpenTelemetry C++ SDK. The local SIP span convention emitted by this module is documented in `modules/opentelemetry/semantic-convention/sip-spans.md`.

dependencies_required.name: OpenTelemetry C++ SDK (opentelemetry-cpp)
dependencies_required.reason: Must be installed before running OpenSIPS with this module loaded

exported_parameters.name: enable
exported_parameters.description:
Enables or disables OpenTelemetry tracing at startup. It can also be changed at runtime using the `opentelemetry:enable` MI command.

The module is built only when the OpenTelemetry C++ SDK is available at build time.

exported_parameters.name: proc_profiling
exported_parameters.description: If enabled, the module will also profile/trace the OpenSIPS processes, not only the script.

exported_parameters.name: log_level
exported_parameters.description: Log level threshold used by the OpenTelemetry log consumer when attaching log events to the active span.

exported_parameters.name: use_batch
exported_parameters.description: Selects the OpenTelemetry span processor. When enabled, the module uses the batch span processor; otherwise it uses the simple span processor.

exported_parameters.name: exporter_endpoint
exported_parameters.description: Overrides the OTLP/HTTP exporter endpoint. If empty, the OpenTelemetry SDK default is used.

exported_mi_functions.name: opentelemetry:enable

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: set to “1” to enable tracing or “0” to disable it.

exported_mi_functions.description: Replaces obsolete MI command: _otel\_enable_. Enables or disables OpenTelemetry tracing at runtime.

examples.code:
## enable tracing
		opensips-cli -x mi opentelemetry:enable enable=1
		## disable tracing
		opensips-cli -x mi opentelemetry:enable enable=0
